result.topic_en: Notes on deriving a theorem from the theorem on perspective triangles without continuity axioms, an analogue of Hoppe's theorem on tetrahedra with equal-area faces in four or more dimensions, and a conjecture on irreducibility of integral polynomials modulo prime powers.
